data.content_ref: inline:CONTRADICTS: Artifact 0e26d6be54fd contradicts SRC_005 (When Conjecture Circles: Repertoire Exhaustion and Refuted-Attractor) because if 0e26d6be54fd represents a successful connection that escaped basin-trapping, it stands as a counter-instance to the repertoire-exhaustion dynamic described in SRC_005 — demonstrating that neighbourhood connection is achievable where SRC_005 predicts cycling. This is REFUTED IF 0e26d6be54fd is itself a record of a failed or still-cycling connection attempt (as the scratch context hypothesizes), in which case it would exemplify rather than contradict SRC_005.
